# @zakkster/lite-sparks

> Zero-GC SoA spark and debris engine. Velocity stretching, floor bounce, thermodynamic OKLCH heat gradient. One dependency.

Version: 1.4.0

## Install
npm i @zakkster/lite-sparks

## Dependencies
@zakkster/lite-color (OKLCH -> CSS string conversion)

## Import
import { SparkEngine } from '@zakkster/lite-sparks';

## Key Facts
- SoA Float32Arrays: x, y, vx, vy, life, invLife, weight + Uint8Array state
- invLife[] precomputed per-spawn -- avoids division in render loop
- Sleep state: physics skipped when vx=0 && vy=0 (resting sparks on floor)
- Air forces (v1.3.0): wind (constant push), gust (sin oscillation), turbulence (per-spark curl) -- one hoisted `if (aero)` gate, skipped when all knobs 0
- Containment (v1.3.1): walls (wallLeft/wallRight/ceiling position clamp + velocity reflection) and vortex (attract radial pull + swirl tangential push toward attractX/attractY)
- Debris vocabulary (v1.4.0): onBounce floor-contact hook (primitives only: x, post-bounce vx, weight; gated by onBounceMinSpeed on pre-bounce speed; NO try/catch), scaleTo/fadeOut per-particle enveloped render lane (life-driven width scale + alpha fade)
- onBounce is one guarded call inside the existing floor branch; scaleTo/fadeOut ride one hoisted `if (enveloped)` render gate -- both null/off by default so the bin-batched lane is byte-identical to v1.3.1
- SPARK_PRESETS (weld/grind/impact/ember) + burstPreset(engine,x,y,preset): zero-alloc positional adapter (no spread, no temp object)
- makeEmitter({x,y,rate,cone,speed,life}): fractional-carry emitter; step(engine,dt) accumulates rate*dt, spawns the integer part, keeps the remainder -- zero alloc per step
- Walls are one hoisted `if (walls)` after the floor block, inside the moving gate (never wake a resting ember); vortex folds into the same `if (aero)` branch
- Vortex accel is normalized and clamped per-axis to +/-VORTEX_MAX_ACCEL (4000, 5x default gravity) so a hostile attract/swirl cannot teleport a spark
- Aero-off + containment-off is byte-identical to v1.2.0: all knobs default 0/null -> aero+walls false -> the per-particle body is unchanged
- drag config: friendlier alias for friction (overrides it when != null; null is not zero)
- Floor restitution: bounce with energy loss, velocity threshold kill
- Vector velocity stretching: each spark is a line from (x,y) to (x-vx*stretch, y-vy*stretch)
- Heat gradient: 4-stop thermodynamic [cherry red -> orange -> yellow -> white-hot]
- Color index from remaining life ratio -- sparks cool as they die
- Pre-parsed OKLCH colors in constructor -- zero allocation in updateAndDraw
- Batched render: counting-sort into (colorIdx*4 + wBucket) bins -> <= colors.length*4 stroke passes/frame (was one per particle)
- wBucket: line width quantized to {0..3} at spawn (cold path); render sets width 1..4px per bin
- Spawn is a ring cursor (head = (head+1) % max), overwrite-oldest -- O(count), evicts the oldest live spark under pressure
- transparentBackground toggle: 'lighter' (dark) vs 'source-over' (light)
- RNG injectable: config.rng defaults to Math.random
- No canvas ownership: engine takes (ctx, dt, w, h)
- destroy() nulls the 9 SoA/color arrays plus the 4 batching scratch buffers, idempotently

## API
- VERSION -- package version string constant
- new SparkEngine(maxParticles?, config?)
- .burst(x, y, count, angleMin, angleMax, speedMin, speedMax, lifeMin?, lifeMax?)
- .updateAndDraw(ctx, dt, w, h) -- physics + render, call once per frame
- .clear() -- kill all particles
- .destroy() -- release all arrays
- SPARK_PRESETS -- frozen { weld, grind, impact, ember } preset descriptors
- burstPreset(engine, x, y, preset) -- zero-alloc positional preset adapter
- makeEmitter({ x, y, rate, cone, speed, life }) -- fractional-carry emitter; .step(engine, dt)

## Config
gravity (800), friction (0.99), floorFriction (0.85), restitution (0.4),
stretch (0.04), drag (null->friction), wind (0), gust (0), turbulence (0),
wallLeft (null), wallRight (null), ceiling (null), attract (0), swirl (0),
attractX (0), attractY (0), onBounce (null), onBounceMinSpeed (0),
scaleTo (1), fadeOut (0), transparentBackground (false), autoClear (true),
floorY (null->h), heatColors (4 OKLCH), rng (Math.random)
- onBounce(x, vx, weight): called on floor contact when pre-bounce downward speed > onBounceMinSpeed; primitives only, must NOT throw or mutate the engine mid-frame (no try/catch); null = no hook (null is not zero)
- scaleTo: per-particle line-width multiplier at end of life (1 = no scale); fadeOut: alpha reduction at end of life (0 = opaque); either non-default flips the enveloped render lane on (one stroke per spark)
- walls: wallLeft/wallRight clamp x + reflect vx, ceiling clamps y + reflects vy (null = no wall; null is not zero)
- vortex: attract pulls toward (attractX, attractY), swirl adds a perpendicular tangential push; both clamped per-axis to +/-4000 px/s^2
- walls + vortex act only on MOVING sparks (inside the S-05 sleep gate) -- they never wake a resting ember
- friction is dt-independent: applied as pow(friction, dt*60), 60fps byte-identical
- drag is an alias for friction: when != null it overrides friction (null is not zero)
- wind is a constant px/s^2 horizontal push; gust adds a sin oscillation (TAU/3 rad/s, 3s period)
- turbulence is a per-spark curl seeded by invLife -- neighbours wander in different directions
- all three air knobs default 0 -> aero gate off -> hot body byte-identical to v1.2.0
- autoClear:false draws over existing pixels (layer over a game/scratch surface)
- floorY null means use h; set it to land sparks on a HUD bar / table edge
- transparentBackground semantics are INVERTED vs lite-fireworks (see README)

## Usage
const sparks = new SparkEngine(5000);
sparks.burst(400, 300, 50, -Math.PI, 0, 200, 800); // upward cone
sparks.updateAndDraw(ctx, dt, w, h); // in RAF loop

## Seeded Random (deterministic)
import { Random } from '@zakkster/lite-random';
const rng = new Random(42);
const sparks = new SparkEngine(5000, { rng: () => rng.next() });
